Customer is reporting that their one time payment is failing when they try to complete it.  Could be that the card is being declined, that the system keeps crashing, that the payment is not being reflected in their account, or not receiving a confirmation message of a payment made.

2.To inquire about a payment that was made in October but did not appear to have been processed
